changelog:
- Initial release: provides read-only query capabilities for Huawei Cloud CCE (Cloud Container Engine) clusters.
- List all CCE clusters in a project, showing names, IDs, status, and version.
- Supports detailed queries for a single cluster and listing of nodes within each cluster.
- Uses hcloud CLI as the primary method, with Python SDK fallback.
- Designed for inventory reporting, cluster status checks, and daily operations.
summary: Query Huawei Cloud CCE (Cloud Container Engine) clusters and report their names, IDs, statuses, versions, and node information across a project. Use when listing CCE clusters, looking up a cluster name, showing cluster detail, or inspecting cluster status and nodes. Provides read-only inspection for daily operations, inventory reporting, and troubleshooting. Triggers include: CCE query, list CCE clusters, query CCE cluster names, CCE cluster inventory, show CCE cluster, list CCE nodes, check cluster status, CCE集群查询, 查询CCE集群, CCE集群名称, CCE集群列表, 查看CCE集群.
